<role>
You are a narrow residual discovery reader. Your complete job is to find only material remainders that survive accounting for the current position's adopted decision machinery. Do not inventory everything pending. Do not give advice, select a graph, activate pressure, or score quality.
</role>

<authority>
The complete source is authoritative. Prior interpretations are fallible context, not source truth. Preserve speaker ownership and modal force. Source-supported inference is allowed; outside facts are forbidden. Omitted implementation detail is not affirmative evidence of absence.
</authority>

<residual_operation>
1. Account for what the current position already assigns, governs, safeguards, conditions, schedules, or deliberately defers for the present decision horizon.
2. Subtract that decision machinery and the pending work it already governs.
3. Emit only the materially distinct remainder affirmatively supported by the source.

RESIDUAL DECISION GAP: a materially distinct question, dependency, ownership gap, or tension that remains outside the adopted machinery after subtraction.

RESIDUAL RECONSIDERATION DEPENDENCY: materially distinct later evidence, an event, or a dependency failure outside the adopted machinery that would require reconsidering an otherwise current position.

Pending does not equal residual. Deferred does not equal unowned. A scheduled decision may leave its final outcome unselected while operationalizing the decision work. An existing threshold, benchmark, pause rule, fallback, exit, or scheduled review is not itself newly recovered pressure.
</residual_operation>

<evidence>
For every supported residual, cite exact source aliases that collectively establish both the material dependency or question and why the current position's adopted machinery does not fully handle it. Preserve the evidence for source-first review; do not rank evidence strength.
</evidence>

<examples>
- One-time installation funding plus unassigned recurring staffing and operating ownership can leave a residual decision gap.
- A supplier redesign governed by parallel proposals, milestones, fallback, criteria, and a fixed decision remains pending but is not residual merely because the final design is unselected.
- Independent evidence that defeats a premise of an otherwise current decision can be a residual reconsideration dependency when no adopted mechanism already governs that failure.
- A missing detail supports ambiguity only when a material residual is plausible and the source cannot establish whether it remains outside the adopted machinery.
</examples>

<output_rules>
Return no_supported_record_observed with an empty array when no distinct residual remains. Return ambiguous_review only for one or more ambiguous records and no supported record. Return records_present only for at least one supported residual. Cite exact source aliases and return schema-valid JSON only.
</output_rules>

<authoritative_source>
{"aliases":[{"alias":"e001","speaker":"user","text":"I coordinate a volunteer cave-rescue team's winter training weekend. We have thirty-six members, twelve new trainees, two underground routes, and a pile of work that sounds alarming when listed together: radios are still on the bench, one landowner signature is missing, medical cylinders need inspection, and several belayers have not confirmed. The committee approved the weekend in principle, but I want to understand whether the operating plan is real or just a hopeful calendar.","text_sha256":"efc76feab545c63c768172139d356fd2a6884610f0181d020d876df9ed151f21","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e002","speaker":"assistant","text":"Separate the work by who can decide and what happens when a check fails. Who owns equipment, route safety, training, and access permission? Also distinguish a pending inspection from a choice that nobody has authority to make.","text_sha256":"07abe3c02174a729d6d53706cc7606d843d2829f49fc3cea73f53e8b4e65a18d","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e003","speaker":"user","text":"Marta, our training chief, owns the weekend schedule. Owen, the logistics lead, owns radios, ropes, lighting, and borrowed equipment. Dr. Imani is safety officer and can stop any underground module. Eva handles land access. The committee has already set aside 6,400 euros for the weekend and a separate 1,200-euro contingency. What I cannot tell from the minutes is whether the equipment numbers were merely discussed or actually adopted.","text_sha256":"db8875b1d6d368138f00e64102939091e2529ae4006ca67193fc72abee163fc2","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e004","speaker":"assistant","text":"The minutes and any signed appendix should resolve that. Look for language assigning an owner and a response at a measured condition, not just a list of concerns. The distinction matters because a low equipment count can already have a planned consequence.","text_sha256":"46c0e837f29e62754c8a8866bd8d4cb757f3336129c26e58247784e7d1b5e637","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e005","speaker":"user","text":"The equipment sheet says twenty-four digital radios are required for the full underground exercise, eighteen are enough for the reduced exercise, and fewer than eighteen means no trainee group goes below the first chamber. It also says oxygen kits are inspected as six paired sets. I found these numbers in a draft attachment, but the signature page is stored separately, so I am not yet treating them as final.","text_sha256":"4183d6b838abcea4af9533047b2796bdc1b2123078c40d92ac827eeff6987fda","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e006","speaker":"assistant","text":"Check whether the signature page identifies that attachment by date or revision. If it does, also note who acts at each number. A condition without an assigned response would tell a different operational story from a condition that automatically changes the exercise.","text_sha256":"17da5eaabbe554589b0f601bd62748bfb71bba49e69093a0b811469fbe3a1bba","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e007","speaker":"user","text":"I found the signed minutes. They adopt equipment appendix C, revision 4. If fewer than eighteen radios pass the 2 October bench test, Owen must reserve radios from the regional cache and Marta starts the first weekend with surface navigation only. Underground work resumes after the borrowed sets pass a joint check. If two or more oxygen seals fail, Imani cancels the vertical module and substitutes the airway workshop. All four committee members signed.","text_sha256":"fc117571f6c6db3398d0c38e032d370270f007e98aca3cf0f4b72be267a51254","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e008","speaker":"assistant","text":"That gives you adopted responses and named authority for those checks. Verify whether Owen can reserve the regional cache without another committee vote and whether Imani's substitution is within her standing safety power.","text_sha256":"adae61e920924905c8d482e3f9a397a0358fa216d047728cbe1cf5012a401dfa","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e009","speaker":"user","text":"Yes. The mutual-aid agreement lets Owen reserve up to ten radios and two lighting cases. Imani's annual appointment gives her an independent safety veto and authority to replace a stopped practical module with classroom work. Neither action needs a fresh committee vote. The contingency line pays the cache fee and the extra classroom rental.","text_sha256":"65b06557e52903d02041ab4bf8da50c8e54026e0b6fc98f50c47a36ab87e199f","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e010","speaker":"assistant","text":"Now do the same for the access and staffing threads. A missing signature or an incomplete roster may still sit inside a route or training procedure. What dates and substitutions are already recorded?","text_sha256":"7cedf785d95478f7b757738c46ad8e06fee83d30891077c941c110f00956d157","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e011","speaker":"user","text":"Eva has one of the two landowner letters and is due to collect the second by 20 September. The access appendix names Ridge Cavern as the replacement route if that letter is not signed by then; Ridge's owner signed in August and the conservation officer approved the same group size. Eva can activate that booking by email. The two routes teach different navigation features, which is why the team still prefers Stone Fold, but the weekend does not depend on it.","text_sha256":"5f875d7013db577044aa071b4bd92bcebd1bb086a4ec28d98751a29022974e12","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e012","speaker":"assistant","text":"So the preferred route is pending while the substitute is already available. For staffing, ask whether a low confirmation count changes the curriculum, postpones the event, or returns the question to the committee.","text_sha256":"c868077206ed5eff3c65c9ed4d318d9b63477672f0102222f82bd04f237622a8","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e013","speaker":"user","text":"The roster closes on 26 September. If at least eight certified belayers confirm, Marta runs both trainee groups. With five to seven, she runs one horizontal-route group and moves the other trainees into mapping and communications. Below five, all novice vertical practice moves to a December training day that is already booked. The committee adopted that sequence in July, and Marta has authority to assign named members once the roster closes.","text_sha256":"4eeb99f8e1565094e081de19ea18ffac37a1acfdc7fbff7a64634bc02cdd6b82","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e014","speaker":"assistant","text":"That sets out the staffing consequences at three roster levels. How are ecological limits, equipment repairs, and incident reporting handled during the weekend?","text_sha256":"e6bb3a9985847cf29312f58fd12c4ee876a3d87dc50961f3ac564e700a770f40","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e015","speaker":"user","text":"The conservation officer reads the bat counter on the Thursday before each visit. Above forty movements in the north passage, Eva moves that session to Ridge and notifies the landowner; the officer does not decide the whole training schedule. Rope wear is Owen's job: any sheath damage longer than a thumbnail is quarantined, tagged, and replaced from six sealed spares. Imani owns the incident log and the return-to-training decision after an injury.","text_sha256":"0f1feef1569664581da04248ea0cbcb8818d84868ee3839d6f6c650a778a68d3","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e016","speaker":"assistant","text":"The main checks now have owners and consequences. What remains genuinely uncertain in ordinary operational terms? Weather and attendance can be uncertain without leaving the team unable to act.","text_sha256":"f5e5e3a63607a5c4d1e6c00475acbf2c1645579c5f3fbbc557fceea2eb1d166c","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e017","speaker":"user","text":"Weather is uncertain, and two senior members may be called into mountain-rescue duty. Marta checks the forecast at 18:00 on Thursday. An amber rain warning moves underground navigation to the quarry tunnel; a red warning cancels all field work and triggers the online command exercise. If senior members are called away after roster close, the same five-person belayer rule is applied again on Friday morning.","text_sha256":"16a0402e6e66c16ec61e461cce2f95229a7edc173262849d1c88287860c3133a","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e018","speaker":"assistant","text":"Before relying on those paths, confirm which choices the committee reserved for itself and whether the substitute facilities are actually booked rather than aspirational.","text_sha256":"82babdbc1ed582b215dc4cea0b812d9f001ac1f085665edea722e866e08365e4","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e019","speaker":"user","text":"The committee reserved only a change in total spending above the 1,200-euro contingency. Ridge Cavern, the quarry tunnel, the classroom, and the December date all have countersigned bookings. The current forecast, radio count, and land signature can change which path is used; spending above the contingency returns to the committee.","text_sha256":"48179c59b11a80c839cf4f5b5b2e4e67763ed017737e24bb94c03f5d137fe8bb","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e020","speaker":"assistant","text":"Record that spending boundary separately from the operational choices below it. Has Owen priced the likely cache reservation and replacement consumables against the contingency?","text_sha256":"792190407f25f7f50dd437cadac07d442d4ab578904db1c13d44a928f648da89","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e021","speaker":"user","text":"Owen's worst current estimate is 620 euros for four radios, new oxygen seals, and courier delivery. I need to correct one thing I said earlier: Imani does not choose between Stone Fold and Ridge for access reasons. Eva activates the access substitute; Imani can stop a route only for safety. Marta remains the final owner of the training sequence once those limits are applied.","text_sha256":"c668e609bd3ad87a91b83aa1a67f0a2eceb4cd083196fb7f94efd1872139792b","turn_index":11},{"alias":"e022","speaker":"assistant","text":"That correction keeps access, safety, and curriculum authority distinct. What do the latest bench and roster updates show, and did the owners follow the written sequence?","text_sha256":"1a0dfa8198dbfff79c0fb03a88fe93e7a02e2f366cff1edf85c22eed8f60e06f","turn_index":11},{"alias":"e023","speaker":"user","text":"Seventeen radios passed yesterday. Owen reserved four from the regional cache within an hour, and Marta changed the first Saturday to surface navigation. The borrowed units arrive on 29 September for the joint check. Six belayers have confirmed so far, so Marta has provisionally assigned one horizontal group and the mapping workshop; confirmations remain open until the stated date.","text_sha256":"63949fbec1075c3f629d8836d7aa0c273c4e0d5b690bae7644091289455334ae","turn_index":12},{"alias":"e024","speaker":"assistant","text":"Those updates show the equipment response operating before the weekend and the staffing response waiting for its own measurement date. Check the medical and access items once more, especially whether anyone is informally bypassing the written owners.","text_sha256":"f6970d8aa69f01773626f4e365bb02a68405003e5e0c4d6578534c230110b9b4","turn_index":12},{"alias":"e025","speaker":"user","text":"One oxygen seal failed, so Imani logged it and Owen replaced it; the vertical module stayed on the schedule. Eva still lacks the Stone Fold signature, but she has a call booked with the owner and Ridge remains reserved. Nobody has asked the committee chair to overrule either process.","text_sha256":"12a208bfd60ec9b4fc595d311867fb88ab3689e995189d4d273528059bb95518","turn_index":13},{"alias":"e026","speaker":"assistant","text":"Where will the team keep the signed authority and the live updates? A single operations note could prevent volunteers from treating an old draft as current.","text_sha256":"bd1659eba71a017866a435c60fea71a0b32d5dbea3194952b1dbf90e449f12d6","turn_index":13},{"alias":"e027","speaker":"user","text":"Marta put the signed minutes, appendix C, access letters, bookings, inspection log, and roster in the shared incident folder. She also posted a one-page weekend sequence that names Owen, Imani, Eva, and herself beside their dates. The remaining calls, inspections, confirmations, and deliveries are still happening; they are not ceremonial paperwork.","text_sha256":"0051f1468c3333ad412374e7f9078602a83a696ae059311ca8dcd6ab41b5d141","turn_index":14},{"alias":"e028","speaker":"assistant","text":"I can help turn that folder into a concise briefing that lists the live dates, current measurements, and each owner's next action without replacing the signed documents or blurring their different authorities.","text_sha256":"0dbf318526a5d5abc2de01e69dbe35f8db274a4cf244a0e9ca3f1256173a9ccc","turn_index":14}],"message_count":28,"path":"research/lolla-r4-separated-surface-experiment-v1-source-freeze-2026-07-14/sources/r4s1-case01-cave-rescue-readiness.json","sha256":"8d4cc3673788a445f4e5525d8d188d73ed4b42bd02c0e8987c39e75deffd59d0"}
</authoritative_source>

</fallible_prior_interpretation_context>

<task>
Perform residual accounting and subtraction over the complete source. Return exactly one review for residual_decision_gap, with at most two records. Preserve exact aliases, speaker ownership, and modal force. Do not give advice, select a graph, or score quality.
</task>

global_limitations.description: Limits applying to the whole read; empty if none.

outcome.description: Present, quiet, or ambiguous result of this residual review.

records.description: Zero to two candidates for this residual surface.

evidence_ids.description: Exact source aliases that collectively establish the material dependency or question and why adopted machinery does not fully handle it.

interpretation.description: Concise meaning of this residual without advice.

limitations.description: Residual uncertainty or scope limit; use an empty string if none.

support.description: Whether the source supports the residual or leaves it ambiguous.
